name: source-ast-semantic-producer-boundary

checks.name: scanner delegates semantic products through one upstream producer
scanner no longer imports expression producer
scanner no longer imports assignment producer
scanner no longer imports property producer
scanner no longer traverses PHP statement semantics
producer owns expression, assignment and property production through the active producers and typed assignment constructor
contract preserves all semantic products as typed outputs
active Laravel source-AST pipeline consumes the three typed products without reselecting producers

residuals: sourceAstSemanticProducer still orchestrates evidence acquisition and syntax parsing internally; this is an open architecture boundary, not a claim that parsing and semantic judgment are already separate.
Route action collision resolution has moved upstream; source-order independence is enforced by sorting canonical route keys before resolving names.
full typecheck/build and end-to-end Laravel fixture execution require project dependencies not included in this workspace.
